paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between context consistency and context inconsistency under the prefix-constrained decoding Setting. The x-aixs denotes the number of tokens for the gold prefix.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the length of the gold prefix and BLEU scores for two different conditions labeled as "Consistency: wait-1" and "Inconsistency: wait-9". The x-axis is labeled "the length of gold prefix" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5 units. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU", with a linear scale ranging from 23 to 29, and tick labels at intervals of 1 unit. The first line, representing "Consistency: wait-1", is shown in blue with circular markers and a dashed line style. This line begins at a BLEU score of approximately 24 at an x-value of 0, dips below 24 around 1, then rises steadily to approximately 28 at an x-value of 20. The second line, representing "Inconsistency: wait-9," is displayed in red with square markers and a solid line style. This line starts at a BLEU score of about 25 at an x-value of 0, maintains a mostly steady trend with small oscillations around 25 and 26, with peaks around 5 and slight troughs around 10, before ending near 26 at an x-value of 20. The two lines intersect each other at around x-value of 9. There are legend corresponding to each line style available in top left part of plot.
